decision_rationale: The paper fine-tunes DNABERT-2 with contrastive learning for DNA barcode identification, so it is an application wrapper rather than a new generative model. The abstract and discussion describe pre-trained multi-species parameters and transfer to zero-shot/fine-tuning benchmarks, but no generative mechanism is stated.
